description:
[Interviews] Create a new interview. Without `questions` its question sequence is generated from the position data. With `questions` (an explicit list) they are stored as you wrote them, and in the session the avatar says each one in its tone, rephrased, unless you pass `interview_tone="exact"`, which reads them verbatim (compliance, translated or legally reviewed text). With `questions`, a rapport question is added first unless include_rapport_question=false (3 sent are 4 asked), and the candidate expectations are generated from them. `type` is the product (interview, assessment, coaching); `interview_type` is the style of an interview (pre-screening, second-interview...); invite-only hiring is visibility=merchant_invite. A position's pre-screening STEP (resume and form) is something else: added with set_position_process, configured with update_position_step. The `interview_template_id` also sets the modality (voice-only vs realtime/pre-recorded avatar); `list_avatars` lists the templates. Full-session recording (recording_full_session) and a longer max_duration raise the credit cost.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

additional_context.description: Arbitrary additional context object merged into AI generation.

candidate_expectations.description: Free-text candidate expectations folded into AI generation.

candidate_expectations_json.description: With questions only: pre-generated candidate expectations, bucketed by requirement level (weak/moderate/strong); generated from your questions when omitted for type interview.

candidate_notification_channel.description: SMS / WhatsApp notifications to the candidate, sent alongside the e-mails: "reminders" = with both e-mail reminders (day 1 and day 3); "last_reminder" = only with the final day-3 reminder; "all" = invitation, both reminders and the pre-screening-accepted step. null switches them off.

candidate_video_introduction.description: Whether a candidate video introduction is optional or required.

code.description: Optional external code/reference for the interview.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

country_availability.description: Which countries the interview / position is open to on the candidate portal, judged by the IP address the candidate opens it from (an unknown location only passes when countries_allowed / countries_allowed_eu are empty). From a closed country it is left out of the portal listings, and a direct link shows "not available in your region". Invited candidates (personal invitation links) and candidates who already started keep access; API and MCP calls themselves are never restricted. Null = not used, every country.

custom_scoring.description: Custom result-scoring overrides merged with defaults and template overrides.

description.description: Short, two-sentence job description shown to the candidate. Required with `questions`. Without `questions`, provide it to use it as-is, or leave it null/blank and it is AI-generated from the position name and any other context.

description_long.description: Full job description in Markdown (Job Purpose, Responsibilities, Required & Preferred Qualifications). Provide it to use it as-is; leave it null/blank and it is AI-generated (interview and assessment types only).

disable_deduplication.description: With questions only: when true, every question is stored as a new record instead of reusing an identical one.

environment.description: Which of your webhook environments results from this interview are delivered to. Defaults to production. Values: `production`: Live hiring | `uat`: User-acceptance testing - an isolated environment for pre-release verification | `development`: Development/testing | `demo`: Demonstrations and sales trials.

hiring_for_company.description: Who the position is really for. Omit/null (or an object with name null/blank) when hiring for yourself; { name: 'undisclosed' } for an unnamed external client; or { name: '<company>' } plus optional description/location/sector/company_size for a named client.

include_closing_prompt.description: Include a closing prompt. Defaults to true.

include_rapport_question.description: Include an opening rapport question. Defaults to false (true when questions is given).

instructional_video.description: Show an instructional video before approval. Defaults to false.

instructional_video_custom_text.description: Custom narration text for the instructional video.

interview_available_till.description: ISO date/time after which the interview is no longer available to candidates. null keeps it always available.

interview_category.description: Job category shown on public listings, above the department (free text, e.g. "Ashore"). Blank is stored as null.

interview_conversation_speed.description: Conversation pace of the AI avatar. Omit/null keeps the template default pace. Values: `slower`: The avatar speaks more slowly | `normal`: Default speaking pace | `faster`: The avatar speaks more quickly for a snappier conversation | `fluent`: Talking pace: the avatar answers 300 ms after the candidate stops speaking.

interview_length.description: Number of questions to generate (1-40). Omit this field to let the AI pick 5-8.

interview_salary.description: Salary range shown for the position.

interview_template_id.description: Id of the interview template to base this interview on.

interview_tone.description: Interview tone — configures the AI avatar's speaking style and the tone of the AI-generated questions and follow-ups. Case-insensitive; omit to default to relaxed. Values: `relaxed`: Friendly and conversational tone that helps candidates feel at ease | `simple`: Plain language at CEFR A2 level | `professional`: Formal and business-like approach suitable for senior roles | `persuasive`: Engaging style that encourages candidates to elaborate | `exact`: Asks the questions exactly as provided, without rephrasing.

interview_type.description: Interview style — configures the AI avatar and shapes both the AI-generated questions and the follow-up questions asked during the interview. Defaults to pre-screening when omitted. Values: `pre-screening`: quick qualification check focusing on basic requirements and availability | `pre-screening-with-test-questions`: pre-screening plus practical questions to test relevant skills | `second-interview`: deeper dive for candidates who passed initial screening | `remote-freelancer-verification`: verify remote work capabilities and communication skills | `strength-based-interview`: focus on what candidates enjoy and excel at to predict job satisfaction | `potential-based-interview`: assess learning ability and growth potential rather than past experience | `process-verification-from-knowledge-base`: generate questions from your knowledge base documents | `knockout-screening`: a short (about 5 minute) check of the role's must-haves with closed questions.

is_embedded.description: Set true when the interview will be embedded as an iframe on an external page. A signed coaching embed (name, email, signature) signs the visitor in as a learner of that portal, and the session is charged to the merchant's interview credits on completion, not to the learner's coaching credits; it cannot start while the merchant has none.

knowledge_base_store_id.description: Knowledge base store id to source additional context from. Documents limited to chosen interviews are left out, because a new interview is on no list yet.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

location.description: Job location — a city/country, or `remote`. Required and must not be empty: when the job description gives no location, pass `Not specified`.

max_duration.description: Maximum interview duration in seconds. Defaults to 1200 (20 minutes) when omitted.

max_followups.description: Maximum number of AI follow-up questions. 0 disables follow-ups; presets are 0-3 (none/low/normal/high) and custom values start at 4; null uses the template default (Normal).

merchant_id.description: Merchant id. Admin / sub-merchant callers only; otherwise taken from your token.

microphone_test_message.description: Custom microphone-test instruction for a recorded (offline avatar) interview, spoken by the avatar and shown on screen before the first question. Omitted uses the default prompt in the interview language.

microphone_test_no_speech_message.description: Custom text shown when the microphone test hears nothing. Omitted uses the default text in the candidate's language.

mojito_language_code.description: Platform language code used for the interview.

pdf_export_auto_config.description: Auto-generate a candidate PDF report with these options once the interview completes. null disables auto-export.

questions.description: OPTIONAL: your own ordered list of questions, in the format get_interview_definition returns. With questions, description becomes required; interview_length and include_closing_prompt are ignored; include_rapport_question defaults to true; max_duration keeps its meaning here (stored, 1200 when omitted). Omit to have the AI generate the description and questions.

questions_random_subset.description: Ask only a random subset of the questions, expressed as a fraction between 0.01 and 0.9 (e.g. 0.5 = 50%). null asks all questions.

recording.description: Cheating/proctoring detection mode for candidate answers — this is NOT a full session recording. Omit, null or `none` to disable. Values: `audio_first_5_answers`: Audio-only cheating detection, first 5 answers only | `audio_all`: Audio-only cheating detection on every answer | `video_all`: Audio + video cheating detection on every answer | `video_first_5_answers`: Audio + video cheating detection, first 5 answers only | `none`: No cheating detection.

recording_full_session.description: Full interview-session recording (includes the avatar and voice) produced as a single file. Omit, null or `none` to disable. Values: `audio_all`: Record the whole session audio | `video_all`: Record the whole session video + audio | `none`: No full-session recording.

recruiter_profile_id.description: Profile id of the recruiter owning this interview. A user of the company who is not read only: an owner, recruiter or admin from list_users.

required_pronunciation.description: Require pronunciation assessment (restricts to pronunciation-capable languages). Defaults to false.

result_enable_edit_transcript.description: Allow editing the transcript on the result view. Defaults to true.

result_view.description: Result screen shown to the candidate after finishing. With any value other than `none`, the candidate sees a results screen where they can provide feedback, record an intro video and edit the transcript, and must then submit the result; the value sets how much score/result detail is shown. Values: `none`: No results screen at all | `minimal`: Minimal results layout, no score shown | `minimal_with_score`: Minimal results layout including the overall score | `advanced`: Advanced results layout with more detail | `full`: Full results layout with all sections | `full_expand_scores`: Full results with every score breakdown expanded.

seniority_level.description: Target seniority level for the role; auto-detected from the job description when omitted. Values: `entry-level`: Early-career or graduate roles | `intermediate`: Some experience required | `senior`: Experienced professional | `managerial`: Team or department lead | `director`: Director-level responsibility | `executive`: C-suite or executive role.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the interview. Values: `draft`: Created but not published | `active`: candidates can run it.

tags.description: Free-form tags stored on the interview. Only `active` sessions with visibility `merchant_public` (or the platform's own `public`) are listed.

thank_you_message.description: Custom thank-you message shown after the interview.

type.description: Product type of the interview. Values: `interview`: Standard candidate interview for a role | `coaching`: candidate-facing feedback to help them improve; not a hiring evaluation | `assessment`: evaluates competencies and is scored like an interview.

visibility.description: Who can discover and access the interview. Values: `merchant_public`: Listed on the merchant's public interview list | `merchant_invite`: only candidates explicitly invited | `merchant_unlisted`: Reachable only via a direct link.

welcome_message.description: Custom welcome message shown to the candidate.
